query: Operators cannot explain why our assistant stopped after two retries. Design events linking request, proposal, policy decision, tool attempts, checkpoint, budget, and final status without logging private reasoning.
Instrument a deployed agent so a lost tool response can be joined to its logical operation, attempt IDs, later receipt, and final persisted state across restart.
Our trace shows model calls but not which prompt, schema, tool, policy, or retrieval version ran. Define a privacy-aware event contract and outcome links needed to compare releases.

Design telemetry for a planner with three workers. Preserve parent-child IDs, causal ordering, conflict resolution, approvals, aggregate spend, and missing-worker outcomes so one trajectory is reconstructable.
We want dashboards for agent abstentions, policy denials, retry exhaustion, unknown effects, and verified success by release. Define bounded labels and alerts with actionable operator queries.
Review logs that copy entire agent contexts and tool payloads. Replace them with bounded redacted fields and restricted evidence pointers while preserving enough information to diagnose failed runs.

An agent evaluator disagrees with the visible result. Link evaluator versions and verdicts to source evidence, receipts, and state transitions, and retain failed attempts even when a later step succeeds.

Specify how to attribute model, retrieval, and worker costs to one logical agent task, including retries and unavailable token usage. Design safe instrumentation rather than estimating missing values as zero.
Prove our new agent event stream is useful: reconstruct a denied action, an approved action, a lost response, and a restart using events alone with fakes for replay.

A support assistant has a scheduler and a manual entry point feeding the same trace sink. Design run identifiers, entry attribution, versions, and safe retention for approvals and side-effect evidence.
Add structured logging, request correlation, RED metrics, distributed tracing, and symptom-based alerts to a conventional payment service. There is no model or agent trajectory to reconstruct.

Define the task-quality rubric for an agent, including groundedness, completeness, abstention, and forbidden effects. Build representative gold cases and calibrate graders; telemetry already captures the necessary evidence.
Implement retry and reconciliation policy for unknown agent commits. Existing traces are adequate; decide budgets, checkpoint recovery, compensation, and poison-task handling.
Profile an agent whose completion time is slow and expensive. Use existing traces to compare context reduction, caching, routing, and independent read parallelism while preserving the quality gate.
Design a checkpoint and memory lifecycle for an assistant, including consent, source provenance, expiry, typed transitions, and deletion. Event instrumentation is outside this request.

Create deterministic runtime tests for an agent using scripted model replies, provider fakes, race conditions, and restart fault injection. We need executable correctness evidence rather than trace design.
Threat-model whether hostile tool outputs can cause file upload or secret leakage. Map attacker-to-effect paths and enforce capabilities; the current telemetry already supports investigation.
Design model-facing lookup and update tools with bounded result payloads, error semantics, and operation keys. Keep telemetry unchanged and focus on contract usability.
Debug a current build failure by reading the error, reproducing it, checking recent changes, and testing one hypothesis. This is a coding defect without an opaque agent run.
Create a review interface for an agent action that needs a manager's judgment. Show exact targets, material diff, denial alternatives, expiry, and cancellation using the existing audit stream.
